name: assignmentId
label: Declarative action assignment ID
description: Sys ID of associated declarative action assignment

name: model
label: Declarative action model
description: Model containing fields associated with current record

date.description: Date and time of when the attachment was created. YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

dateLabel.description: Label for date and time of when the attachment was updated on display. YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

isEncrypted.description: Marked true if attachment is encrypted, otherwise it is marked false.

parentRecordSysId.description: Sys ID for the parent record

parentTable.description: Name of the table that the parent record belongs to

table.description: Table that the attachment belongs to

userId.description: ID of the user who uploaded the attachment

userName.description: Name of the user who uploaded the attachment

type.description: Type of source action that is being triggered
